concerns.text: FR-018 (a priori power analysis) is not explicitly anchored to any user story. Add a reference such as “(see US-2)” or incorporate the requirement into the scope of User Story 2.

SC-012 (verification of the a priori power analysis) lacks a story anchor. Link it to the appropriate story (e.g., US-2) or move it under an existing success criterion that already references the power analysis.

The specification requires 5 stochastic runs for each ablation configuration **plus** training of the main model, all to be completed within a 6‑hour wall‑clock limit on a free‑tier GitHub Actions runner (2 CPU cores, 7 GB RAM). Empirical evidence from prior QM9 GNN training indicates that a single 3‑layer MPNN on ≥10 k molecules typically exceeds several hours on CPU; multiplying by ≥10 full training runs will almost certainly breach the time budget, preventing the study from being executed and thus invalidating the ability to answer the research question.
